results: 1. serum lithium and drug levels: serum lithium 4.07 mmol/L on admission; CSF lithium 2.45 mmol/L; later fell below 0.2 mmol/L
2. brain MRI: cerebellar atrophy at one year; serial imaging over five years shows progressive ISOLATED cerebellar atrophy with no supratentorial abnormality
3. medication history: no prior lithium use and no psychiatric indication - the exposure was accidental
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Syndrome of irreversible lithium-effectuated neurotoxicity (SILENT), presenting as delayed progressive isolated cerebellar atrophy from accidental acute lithium poisoning.

Alternative 1: Acute lithium-induced cerebellar toxicity without permanent neurodegeneration.

Alternative 2: Other toxic or metabolic cerebellar degeneration.

Alternative 3: Hereditary spinocerebellar ataxia.
